August 16-19, 2007
http://www.gencon.com/2007/indy/

Effectively the 13th Anniversary for Vampire: The Eternal Struggle.

Two weeks after the European Championships and four weeks before the
North American Continental Championship.

May be difficult to get travelling players to this event.

Looks like event submission is closed.

Event Submission Deadline
Friday, April 6th

http://www.white-wolf.com/events/search.php would seem to indicate
that there are 0 events scheduled in Indiana for the rest of the year.

However, when I searched here:

http://community.gencon.com/files/folders/pmcompletecatalogs/entry105482.aspx

I found these:

White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00186 Undue Influence
White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00187 Switchblade of Caine
White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00188 US Nationals I
White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00189 Phased Motion Format
White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00190 US Nationals II
White Wolf/ VEKN LSJ TCG00191 Scattershot

Undue Influence Unsanctioned. Alternate rules: Transfers increase
until each player has 5. Moving a minion to the ready region during
the influence phase costs 1 transfer. Drawing the next card from your
crypt costs 5 transfers and 1 pool. TCG - Tradable Card
Game 2 Thursday 2007-08-16 16:00:00

Switchblade of Caine Sanctioned Booster Draft: 2 Sword of Caine
boosters + 2 3rd Edition boosters. 2Rounds + final. TCG -
Tradable Card Game 6 Thursday 2007-08-16 19:00:00

US Nationals I Sanctioned Booster Draft. 3 Third Edition and 2 Sword
of Caine boosters per player. 2R+F, and results used in crowning the
US champion. TCG - Tradable Card Game 8 Friday 2007-08-17 10:00:00

Phased Motion Format Unsanctioned 2 rounds. Rules available at
http://www.boardgamegeek.com/fileinfo.php?fileid=11418
www.boardgamegeek.com/fileinfo.php?fileid=11418
TCG - Tradable Card Game 4 Friday 2007-08-17 19:00:00

TCG00190 US Nationals II Sanction constructed. Qualifier for
the North American Continental Championship. 3R+F, and results used in
crowning the US champion. Total GWs from both I and II (including the
finals) determine the champion. Ties broken by using the just GWs from
the two finals, then by total VPs, then by final VPs. TCG -
Tradable Card Game 8 Saturday 2007-08-18 10:00:00

TCG00191 Scattershot Unsanctioned multi-deck constructed.
3R+F. Multie-deck means you can play with a different deck each round.
Will be sanctioned if ten or fewer players participate. Multi-judge
rules in effect. TCG - Tradable Card Game 8 Saturday 2007-08-19
10:00:00
